pretreatments.description: Concentrated phosphoric acid pretreatment: 83-85.9% phosphoric acid at 50°C for 50 min, followed by addition of acetone, centrifugation, and washing with distilled water twice. The resulting supernatant was heated to remove acetone and then frozen.
Organosolv pretreatment: Ethanol (75% v/v) at 150°C for 30 min with 1% sulfuric acid catalyst, followed by separation of liquid and solid phases.
Dilute sulfuric acid pretreatment: 0.5% w/w sulfuric acid at 140°C for 5 min, followed by separation of liquid and solid phases.
Steam pretreatment: Steaming at 220°C supplemented with 2.4% SO₂ for 50 min.
Alkali pretreatment: NaOH and different combinations of NaOH, thiourea, urea, and polyethylene glycol at − 15°C.
N-methylmorpholine-N-oxide pretreatment: Solvent recovery needed, pretreatment time 15 h at 130°C.
